item.title: NIH’s Bhattacharya acknowledges absence of causal link between vaccines and autism
item.description: Pressed by Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-VT), NIH Director Jay Bhattacharya acknowledged that he is not aware of any study pointing to a causal link between vaccines and autism. “I have not seen a study that suggests any single vaccine causes autism,” Bhattacharya said at a hearing of the Senate Health, Education, Labor and Pensions Committee.
